question: Where was the 2024 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix held in December 2024?

options.text: Yas Marina Circuit on Yas Island

solution:
The correct answer is __**Yas Marina Circuit on Yas Island**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2024 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix** was the final round of the **2024 Formula One World Championship**, held on **8 December 2024**.
 
• The race took place at the **Yas Marina Circuit**, which is located on **Yas Island** in **Abu Dhabi**, the capital of the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**.
 
• Since its debut in **2009**, the **Yas Marina Circuit** has frequently served as the season finale for **Formula One**, providing a high-tech backdrop for the conclusion of the championship.
 
• The circuit is unique for its **day-night transition**, as the race begins during the late afternoon in **daylight** and finishes under **floodlights** after **sunset**.
